import sys,random,time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission');sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
from compiler import compile_plan,find_deficient_cut
from compiler_proto import validate_plan
random.seed(2025)
for case in range(30):
 n=48
 # participants 32, switches 16
 C=list(range(32))
 links=[];used=set()
 # connect switches to participants/backbone links
 # random tree over all nodes
 for v in range(1,n):
  u=random.randrange(v)
  used.add(tuple(sorted((u,v))))
 # extras up to 128
 poss=[(u,v) for u in range(n) for v in range(u+1,n) if (u,v) not in used]
 random.shuffle(poss)
 es=list(used)
 es += poss[:128-len(es)]
 random.shuffle(es)
 for u,v in es:links.append((u,v) if random.random()<.5 else (v,u))
 # choose capacities around modest values; roots maybe near feasible
 scale=random.choice([1,2,5,10,20,50])
 caps_choice=[1*scale,2*scale,5*scale,10*scale,20*scale]
 env={i:random.choice(caps_choice) for i in range(len(links))}
 p=random.choice([1,2,3])
 # try random roots until feasible, with total scaled small
 roots=None
 for at in range(200):
  # mostly small
  roots={i:random.choice([0,1,2,3,5,10])*scale for i in C}
  if sum(roots.values())==0:roots[C[0]]=scale
  if find_deficient_cut(n,links,C,roots,p,env) is None:break
 else:
  print('case',case,'no feasible');continue
 t=time.time()
 try:
  out,pay=compile_plan(n,links,C,roots,p,env);dt=time.time()-t
 except Exception as e:
  print('FAIL',case,'D',sum(roots.values()),'scale',scale,repr(e));raise
 if out=='denied':print('denied',case);continue
 print('case',case,'D',sum(roots.values()),'scale',scale,'trees',len(pay['trees']),'routes',len(pay['routes']),'recipes',len(pay['recipes']),'time',round(dt,2),flush=True)
 validate_plan(pay,n,links,C,roots,p,env)
